notes.title: Unexpected Downtime and Recovery Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

For players who may have missed our updates on social media and updates on our Steam Forums, we want to provide a full recap of what has been happening behind the scenes over the past few weeks and share the latest progress on restoring our servers.

On February 2nd, all three of our world wide data centers went dark and all our servers went offline without notice. We were informed by our primary network hosting provider they had encountered a serious issue requiring an unspecified amount of days to fix. This forced Fallen Earth and GamersFirst offline. Unfortunately, we were not provided with an ETA at the time, but we immediately began working with our provider to resolve the issue.

After ongoing discussions, we were initially told services would be restored by Friday, February 7th. However, as delays continued, and deadlines were missed, we made the very difficult decision to terminate all services and implement an entirely new hosting solution to regain control over our infrastructure and ensure long-term stability.

This process has involved quickly securing all of our existing servers, acquiring new servers to meet player demand, and kicking off multiple network colocation and transit contracts around the world. Once we secured new servers, our team began working on restoring services.

As of right now, here is what we have accomplished for Fallen Earth, APB Reloaded and GamersFirst:

 2/21 (Friday): Network circuits were scheduled for provisioning and activation.
 2/24 (Monday): Hosting cabinets were finalized and handed over for setup.
 Server Racking Begins: We moved and racked all the necessary hardware for both NA and EU data centers.
All servers in North America have been set up, and we are currently waiting for one final part before going live.

In Europe, hardware has been moved to Amsterdam, racked, and plugged in. We are now waiting on circuit activation. Our CEO is currently in Amsterdam, tirelessly overseeing everything to ensure a smooth transition. Our team is actively working on-site in both locations to complete the setup as quickly as possible.

We truly appreciate the patience and support from our dedicated players. This transition has been a massive undertaking, and we are doing everything possible to ensure that APB Reloaded and Fallen Earth return stronger than before.

We are posting regular updates on our Discord, and we welcome everyone to join us there for the latest news and discussions: discord.gg/littleorbit


We will continue providing updates via Steam, Discord, and social media as we approach the final stages of this process.

Thank you for being patient with us and we'll see you back in-game soon!

notes.title: Coffee induced update
notes.notes: We were near the home stretch and had a portion of the backup fail. We've now restarted that portion and are estimating that the server should be up at approximately 7 pm provided all goes well.  Thank you all for your patience during this outage, we will not stop until the server is back in service.

notes.title: Server Rollback Update
notes.notes: Update:  We are on the last steps of the rollback process. While we cannot give an exact time of when the server will be back in service,  we have been working all night to ensure that we are open as soon as safely possible

notes.title: Server Downtime Update
notes.notes: The rollback is taking much longer then we anticipated, we'll be moving this out by approximately 6 more hours.

notes.title: Update Server Downtime -
notes.notes:
The Fallen Earth servers are coming back in service and we apologize for the unexpected downtime. We have isolated a problem with the Auction House that was causing lag in various forms (chat, item, spawning). All items on that were placed on the Auction House will fall under one of these categories:

1. if your auction had a buyout price, you'll be receiving that buyout instead of getting the item back
2. if there is no buyout price and no bidder, we're sending the items back to the owner for the Auction. Bids and posting fees should be returned as normal by the auction system. 
3. if you were the highest bidder on an auction, you'll receive the item . 

This will happen over the course of the next 4 hours. 

We will be sending out compensation to all players that have logged in over the last 90 days. Please watch for this to the email address that is registered for your Fallen Earth account.

Thank you for your patience and we will continually monitor the servers over the next few days to ensure their stability.

notes.title: New Release - Fallen Earth Free-to-Play
notes.notes:
Fallen Earth Free-to-Play is now available on Steam.

It’s 2156, and the world has been destroyed by both nuclear and bio-chemical means. Your story takes place in one of the few habitable places left in the world, the Grand Canyon. As a clone with an uncertain past, your job is survival in a world now built on destruction, betrayal and fragile factional alliances.

Returning Steam players of Fallen Earth-Blood Sport will receive two special loyalty items:

3 Days of Commander Premium – Enjoy the benefits of the highest level Premium package available in Fallen Earth, including increased XP gain, crafting speed, a 20% Marketplace discount and the team effect Commander Aura which grants your premium benefits to your entire group (and is stackable)!

Trashy the Hermit Crab – This oversized hermit crab serves as a loyal companion in the Wasteland, and provides you with 5 extra inventory slots!
